h1: Sestriere ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Sestriere sits on its pass at 2,035 metres - the operator claims it as the highest resort in Europe - with 20 lifts and 85 slopes of its own. It is the busiest of the eight resorts on the Vialattea pass, which together open 400 kilometres of skiable area running west across the border to Montgenèvre in France.
stayOverview: Sestriere is a purpose-built resort on the pass itself, built around its two landmark towers, with the lifts leaving from the village. Sauze d'Oulx and the other Vialattea villages are down either side.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. The village is small enough that most of it is a walk from a lift.
rentalCars: Sestriere is about 100 kilometres west of Turin, up the Val Susa and over the pass.
